newsitem.title: USA: GPU's Pa. Electric tenders for preferred.
newsitem.headline: GPU's Pa. Electric tenders for preferred.

text.p: Pennsylvania Electric Co, a unit of GPU Inc, said Wednesday it was offering to purchase any and all of its:
(a) 56,810 outstanding shares of Cumulative Preferred Stock, 4.40% Series B at $73.44 per share;
(b) 97,054 outstanding shares of Cumulative Preferred Stock, 3.70% Series C at $59.64 per share;
(c) 63,696 outstanding shares of Cumulative Preferred Stock, 4.05% Series D at $67.61 per share;
(d) 28,739 outstanding shares of Cumulative Preferred Stock, 4.70% Series E at $78.45 per share;
(e) 42,969 outstanding shares of Cumulative Preferred Stock, 4.50% Series F at $75.11 per share; and
(f) 75,732 outstanding shares of Cumulative Preferred Stock, 4.60% Series G at $76.79 per share.
The utility noted the December 1996 dividend for each series of preferred has been declared and is to be paid on December 1, record November 12.

It said the purchase offers are not conditioned on any minimum number of shares being tendered. Each of the offers and withdrawal rights is scheduled to expire at 2400 EST December 13/0500 GMT December 14.
